modalLead: A correction to what the dashboard shows you after a change. Deleting a bookmark left its row on the page until you reloaded, and while it sat there it answered nothing — the same fault made a category flash the wrong names for a moment when a tag was added.

items.text: A deleted bookmark leaves the page straight away. It was always really deleted — gone from the file, and gone after a reload — but the row stayed on screen until you reloaded, and while it sat there it ignored its own right-click menu, because it still pointed at a bookmark that no longer existed. Deleting a whole category at once left the same rows behind.

Adding a tag no longer flashes the wrong names. For a moment every row in a category showed the same bookmark, before settling down again. It was the same fault: the redraw that follows a change was stopping partway through a category heading, so everything after it kept what it had.
